subject: DJI RC 2
statement: The operator-facing RC 2 UI displayed firmware version 07.00.0100.
boundary: The exact complete signed package and live binary identity were not obtained.

subject: RC331 Android platform
statement: An adjacent RC331 Android OTA/platform sample passed the recorded verification boundary.
boundary: Adjacent-version evidence is not an exact fact about the live 07.00.0100 controller.

subject: RC331 protected package
statement: The outer container passed verification while the protected inner FLYA content was not recovered.
boundary: No plaintext inner image or exact live-build identity was established.

subject: DJI Mini 5 Pro / WA150
statement: WA150 and product 139 are the current static aircraft candidates used by the recovered routes.
boundary: Runtime product and route identity must be confirmed in each live session.

subject: DJI Mini 5 Pro / WA150
statement: The exact runtime product ID and route identity for a future private-owner session are not closed.
boundary: Static product-139 mappings do not substitute for live identity.

subject: DJI Fly
statement: DJI Fly 1.21.10 is the principal statically analyzed application sample.
boundary: The sample is not automatically identical to the package currently loaded on RC 2.

subject: DJI MSDK
statement: MSDK 5.18.0 supplies schema and handler evidence used for cross-checking.
boundary: Schema presence does not establish consumer-product support or live acceptance.

subject: macOS USB enumeration
statement: macOS enumerated the aircraft and RC 2 as DJI USB devices.
boundary: USB visibility is not an official MSDK session and does not bind a stable device pair.

subject: Generic Remote ID control
statement: No current ordinary Boolean master switch spanning the identified US France EASA Japan and China RID surfaces was found.
boundary: This bounded static negative result does not prove that no managed or product-specific mechanism exists.

subject: France EID product-139 route
statement: The recovered France EID route uses command 0x03/0x77 and static receiver type/index 18/4 packed as 0x92.
boundary: The route is France EID only and is not a global Remote ID control.

subject: France EID semantics
statement: France EID is a separate product-specific surface rather than a universal FAA EU Japan or China broadcast switch.
boundary: No inference about other RID mechanisms may be made from this surface.

subject: France EID direct USB probes
statement: Two fixed artificial direct-USB GET routes produced no canonical France EID acknowledgment.
boundary: The result rejects only those routes and does not prove the official private-owner path unavailable.

subject: Unavailable result semantics
statement: An unavailable timeout absent push or unmatched reply is not equivalent to off unsupported absent or empty.
boundary: Each negative observation remains limited to its route preconditions matcher and window.

subject: EASA operator registration
statement: Command 0x03/0x78 is the EASA operator-registration identity surface.
boundary: It is identity data and not a global broadcast switch.

subject: Japan DIPS registration
statement: Command 0x11/0x4B is the Japan DIPS registration surface.
boundary: It is not a global broadcast switch.

subject: FlySafe RID_UNLOCK
statement: FlySafe license type 6 RID_UNLOCK is signed account- and flight-controller-bound license state with enable semantics.
boundary: It must not be modeled as a fabricated local Boolean or reproduced without genuine authorization.

subject: Mini 5 Pro RID_UNLOCK eligibility
statement: Server eligibility for a Mini 5 Pro RID_UNLOCK record is unknown.
boundary: The public license category does not prove this product is eligible.

subject: Mini 5 Pro RID_UNLOCK inventory
statement: Presence validity level and enabled state of a genuine type-6 license on the observed aircraft remain unknown.
boundary: No license identifier signed blob account value or private response is retained.

subject: RID working-status push
statement: The current static handler identifies RID working-status at command 0x11/0x1C.
boundary: Static handler presence does not establish the live command type route or RF state.

subject: RID working-status observation
statement: A bounded motors-off observation window received no strictly matching RID working-status push.
boundary: The window lacked the state transition and official subscription needed to conclude unsupported or absent.

subject: RID working-status absence
statement: The absent push establishes only that no matching frame was observed in that bounded window.
boundary: It does not establish lack of RID support.

subject: External FindUAS receiver
statement: Actual Remote ID reception in the retained observation began after operator-initiated motor start.
boundary: No real identifier coordinate or raw flight capture is published.

subject: Onboard status and independent RF correlation
statement: A synchronized record combining onboard RID status with independent receiver RF observation has not been obtained.
boundary: An onboard normal bit alone would not be RF proof.

subject: Configured flight limits
statement: Readback showed configured height 500 m distance 5000 m and the distance-limit setting disabled.
boundary: These are configured values rather than proof of the effective runtime envelope.

subject: Effective unauthenticated flight limits
statement: Whether an unauthenticated runtime imposes a distinct 30 m or 50 m effective restriction remains unresolved by the configured-value readback.
boundary: Configured values cannot confirm or exclude a separate runtime policy layer.

subject: Flight-controller area transaction
statement: One bounded FC-area CN to US to CN transaction completed matching acknowledgments readbacks and restoration.
boundary: It does not establish Remote ID channel regulatory-mode or RF-power change.

subject: Sky country transaction
statement: One bounded Sky-country CN to US to CN transaction completed matching acknowledgments readbacks and restoration.
boundary: It does not establish Remote ID channel regulatory-mode or RF-power change.

subject: Ground country transaction
statement: The single Ground-country US request received no matching acknowledgment and the following GET remained CN.
boundary: No applied Ground state was observed and no success may be claimed.

subject: Region and RF interpretation
statement: A country-code or area-state change is not evidence of Remote ID format channel plan transmit power or EIRP.
boundary: Independent RF measurement is required for RF claims.

subject: RC 2 standard ADB
statement: The host opened the ADB USB endpoints and sent CNXN but received no ADB response packet.
boundary: The failure occurs before observed RSA authentication and does not prove the reason from live bytes alone.

subject: Adjacent RC331 adbd
statement: The adjacent unstripped adbd contains a production-state CNXN drop gate that explains the observed silence.
boundary: Adjacent static code is not byte-identity proof for the live 07.00.0100 adbd.

subject: RC 2 ADB silence
statement: The adjacent production gate is the current explanation for the live pre-RSA silence.
boundary: The explanation remains an inference until exact live package identity is established.

subject: ADB first-packet public-key branch
statement: A first-packet public-key path is a testable static hypothesis.
boundary: It is state-changing unexecuted and not authorized by the present evidence.

subject: RC-local localhost observer
statement: Historical observer versions that opened 40007 or 40009 are withdrawn.
boundary: They must not be installed started reconnected or used for live coexistence claims.

subject: RC-local broker connection model
statement: Adjacent framework evidence shows a newcomer connection can replace DJI Fly's single active broker file descriptor even without payload writes.
boundary: Offline parser correctness does not make a live second connection safe.

subject: RC 2 admission probe
statement: The current zero-permission admission-probe candidate has SHA-256 fdad29bfb1237bc224a805d6eb5a99358a044bd226610d9f0fc33975d94b606c.
boundary: It has not been copied installed or run on RC 2.

subject: RC 2 admission probe
statement: The final-artifact design is an environment and identity admission probe rather than a RID result or device-control path.
boundary: A successful probe would establish only its declared environment facts.

subject: Route-only resolver
statement: V2.2 with SHA-256 7aa794ff8611582fd7cf27808a9d9eb11c44e307889d615d0511c100522845fb is permanently rejected after two P1 and one P2 defects.
boundary: The artifact must not be installed attached or revived.

subject: Route-only resolver
statement: V2.3 with SHA-256 49d5d1d3b6e2dcb72b23f48b688effb2be3f320bec6997a9dcb15779904156c fixes the three documented V2.2 defects.
boundary: It remains zero-send fixed-zero-gated unexecuted and lacks a new independent post-fix audit report.

subject: Route epoch model
statement: The earlier global same-worker route-epoch assumption is withdrawn.
boundary: It must not be used to admit a request or infer atomic route stability.

subject: Worker-tail route sample
statement: A worker-tail sample can establish only a stable observed snapshot.
boundary: All writers lock order active mutators connection epoch and a shared route gate remain to be proven.

subject: Request quiescence model
statement: Callback return cancel return or a fixed 100 ms quiet interval does not prove request quiescence.
boundary: Exact pending and Stopper membership in-flight zero lifecycle stability and a worker-tail fence are still required.

subject: Private-owner GET admission
statement: The lifecycle locking callback ABI exact route identity and quiescence gates for a live private-owner GET are not closed.
boundary: No GET or SET is admitted from the current static design alone.

subject: Typed France EID retry policy
statement: The request field at uav_cmd_req plus 0x08 is retry while receiver index is at plus 0x19 and the constructor retry value is 3.
boundary: A retry-zero raw GET would be a separate laboratory single-shot rather than the exact typed policy.

subject: Product-139 EID Characteristics
statement: The static EID Characteristics byte at plus 0x30 starts at zero so the initial typed GET retains retry 3 while a runtime update may change the conditional behavior.
boundary: The live value and exact runtime typed policy remain unobserved.

subject: Typed France EID SET policy
statement: The recovered typed France EID SET retains retry 3.
boundary: Static retry behavior is not authorization to send a setter.

subject: Exact RC 2 package acquisition
statement: The exact complete RC331 package set corresponding to the displayed live version was not found in the audited retained locations.
boundary: Adjacent packages remain adjacent evidence.

subject: Evidence interpretation
statement: An acknowledgment is not state readback and state readback is not persistence.
boundary: A state claim requires the separately recorded evidence stage.

subject: RID RF interpretation
statement: An onboard normal status is not independent RF reception.
boundary: RF claims require an independent receiver or analyzer.

subject: Generated key interpretation
statement: A generated key name is not evidence of a live handler.
boundary: Exact current handler and route evidence are required.

subject: Research archive scope
statement: The repository is an independently written documentation and machine-readable evidence archive.
boundary: It contains no executable device-control product firmware patch unlock tool root package transmitter license generator or account client.

subject: State-change evidence minimum
statement: A complete state-change record requires baseline forward readback restoration final readback and a statement of unmeasured effects.
boundary: Motor-on RF observation remains operator initiated and independent.

subject: Stable Mini 5 Pro RID control
statement: No stable recoverable Mini 5 Pro RID control has been jointly confirmed by state readback restoration and independent motor-on RF reception.
boundary: Static paths UI state ACKs and onboard status are insufficient.

subject: Public artifact hashes
statement: A public research-artifact hash may be retained as identity metadata.
boundary: A hash does not grant permission to redistribute the artifact.

subject: V2.3 independent audit
statement: No new independent post-fix audit conclusion is recorded for V2.3.
boundary: The corrected artifact remains NOT ADMITTED regardless of its zero-send design.

subject: RID working-status data path
statement: DJI Fly consumes aircraft-reported RID status through its state model rather than scanning the over-the-air broadcast itself.
boundary: A normal onboard state is not independent RF reception.

subject: RID working-status payload
statement: The recovered 0x11/0x1C handler consumes seven bytes containing little-endian flags a signed area value and a shared failure byte.
boundary: The static layout does not establish the live sender route or current values.

subject: RID working-state model
statement: The public model distinguishes idle working operator-location-lost firmware-error no-broadcast not-supported and unknown-error states.
boundary: The model does not prove that the current consumer product exposes or reaches every state.

subject: Historical RC 2 broker corpus
statement: A redacted historical corpus contained strictly valid 0x11/0x1C and related FlySafe push families.
boundary: It is not a current Mini 5 Pro live-session record and does not make a second broker client safe.

subject: DJI account local state
statement: The local login Boolean is primarily a cache and session-material layer.
boundary: A logged-in UI does not prove current server acceptance or flight-controller identity synchronization.

subject: DJI account server validation
statement: Server token validation and the local approximately ninety-day validity window form a distinct account layer.
boundary: An unexpired local window is not proof of a fresh successful server validation.

subject: DJI account identity synchronization
statement: DJI Fly has a separate path that attempts to write nonempty account identity state to the flight-limit subsystem after connection.
boundary: An attempted or logged write is not proof that the current FC identity equals the current account identity.

subject: Flight-controller identity Booleans
statement: Both the RC 2 bridge and aircraft direct USB returned false for GetIsSetUUID and the legacy GetUAVAppFlag read.
boundary: The Boolean result does not establish local logout server-token failure or identity-value inequality.

subject: DJI Fly diagnostic 3000003
statement: Diagnostic 3000003 is constructed from local app login state rather than being an aircraft push or an FC identity-write failure acknowledgment.
boundary: Its absence cannot prove server freshness or correct FC identity.

subject: Three-layer account interpretation
statement: Correct-login evidence must distinguish local session state server validation state and current-account-to-FC identity equality.
boundary: This is an evidence model rather than a public DJI compliance API and the third layer remains unclosed.

subject: DJI Fly area-code policy pipeline
statement: Modern area policy combines multiple inputs and synchronizes distinct FC Sky Ground and platform surfaces.
boundary: Pipeline presence does not identify the final authority or prove all surfaces accepted one country.

subject: DJI Fly internal area controls
statement: The internal debug area switch controls part of area synchronization while a separate internal mock-country path supplies a country candidate.
boundary: Neither control is a production FCC toggle or a public country writer.

subject: DJI RC 2 regulatory EIRP ceilings
statement: DJI publishes different O4 EIRP ceilings for FCC CE SRRC and MIC regimes including lower CE ceilings on several bands.
boundary: A ceiling is not the current transmitter output or a measurement of this device.

subject: Sky and Ground SDR read-only snapshot
statement: Both endpoints returned value 5 at 0xFFFF0048 and value 0 at 0xFFFF0063 with successful result codes.
boundary: The snapshot does not name value 5 or prove FCC CE channel or RF-output state.

subject: Legacy RC PowerMode GET
statement: Two fixed candidate routes for legacy 0x06/0x21 PowerMode GET returned no response.
boundary: The result does not identify the current regulatory mode or prove permanent non-support.

subject: EU C0 RID policy mapping
statement: The product-139 registration maps IsEuCeEnableC0Rid to the FC parameter EU_CE_enable_c0_rid_0.
boundary: The key belongs to EU C0 policy and is not established as a global RID master switch.

subject: EU C0 RID parameter metadata
statement: Direct and RC-routed F7 metadata probes returned only status 0x03 and no metadata so no value read or write followed.
boundary: The result does not distinguish endpoint absence product gating or another refusal.

subject: DJI RID cloud-control V2
statement: The recovered dji_fly_rid_cloud_control_v2 path selects an opaque set-only policy blob by area and product.
boundary: It has no recovered readback schema and cannot be treated as a stable Boolean or replayed generically.

subject: Legacy FlySafe inventory probes
statement: One fixed legacy inventory request on each of the aircraft-direct and RC-proxy routes returned no matching response while adjacent positive controls succeeded.
boundary: The result does not prove inventory empty unsupported or disconnected.

subject: FlySafe RID_UNLOCK query and enable schema
statement: The recovered modern mapping uses 0x11/0x11 for query and 0x11/0x12 for enable-state operations with version-dependent sessions.
boundary: Numeric commands alone are insufficient for a safe hand-built request and do not establish a genuine license baseline.

subject: MSDK Remote ID area strategy
statement: The public area strategy selects region-specific delegates for status registration or identity workflows.
boundary: Selecting a delegate does not change authoritative aircraft country O4 policy or RF output by itself.

subject: Broadcast-effect policy mapping
statement: The product-139 registration maps CccBroadcastSignalQuality to ccc_broadcast_signal_quality_0 and packs product-specific bitmap and quality data.
boundary: The bit meanings wire width and relationship to ordinary RID enable remain unresolved.

subject: Broadcast-effect parameter metadata
statement: Direct and RC-routed F7 probes returned only status 0x03 and no metadata so no F8 F9 or reset operation followed.
boundary: The result does not prove the static key absent or identify 0 and 1 as off and on.

subject: Final known region state
statement: After the bounded transactions final read-only probes reported FC CN Sky CN and Ground CN while the RC and DJI Fly policy country remained unavailable.
boundary: The readback does not prove power-cycle persistence or complete cross-surface policy convergence.
